notes: Dev TBox expansion, paired with geography-replace-d005 (every country in the Southern Hemisphere: summer from December to February to June to August): keeps the revision's relation (has_summer_in) and new object (June to August) and puts them on a made-up class, the Veldrin outpost, a kind of research base. The first version named real bases (Macquarie Island, South Georgia, Kerguelen), all in the Southern Hemisphere, where the model holds summer as December to February, so the rule overrode a held fact and was a revision in disguise. The members are now invented bases with no stated location (Corvane Base, Quillmere Station, Tarnholt Base), so nothing the model holds fixes their summer and the class rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops, membership in the prompt; the third an application).
